'''Jan-Willem Sipkes''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 3rd at [[2000 Bochum Grand Slam]] on 30 January 2000 with Profit with inserts, according to Koen Meijssen's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d220">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-03-bochum-grand-slam-germany-01-30-00d220/ bochum-grand-slam-germany-01-30-00], DeckTech (Koen "Mr. Pink" Meijssen, 3 February 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-03-bochum-grand-slam-germany-01-30-00d220/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
